# Ginger

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>

## Appearance

Ginger has gorgeous green and gold plumage. He features wicked golden eyes and can ruffle his feathers until he resembles a simple ball of green and gold.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P37](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0037)_

## Personality

Ginger is an unholy bird known for profane speech habits. The bird exhibits a suspicious and sarcastic demeanor toward others.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Ginger was a parrot named by [James A](../character/james-a.md). Harrison's sailor brother, who sent Ginger to [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) while dying. Ginger had once bitten out a piece of John Henry Carter's neck and ultimately caused Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott, to leave him. Known for hurling insults during visits, Ginger was later killed when a severe hailstorm struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), +6 more_
